extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 2 test build: browsing, metadata and Trakt (playback arrives in stage 4).
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.2.0: Trakt. Sign in with a code on trakt.tv; My films, My TV shows with Next up, shows in progress, upcoming and recent episodes, recommendations and Trakt lists; watched marks, resume points and season progress; Trakt actions on every title (watched, collection, watchlist, favourites, lists, rate, hide, clear resume point); background sync of only what changed; Trakt sync in Tools. 0.1.4: Advanced artwork sizes now sit directly under Artwork quality, with no empty heading left behind. 0.1.3: One search for films, TV shows and people; actors' and directors' pages; related titles and cast (context menu); TV networks, new shows and streaming services; sortable lists; hide options per menu; customisable home menu; episode title styles; highlight colour; Advanced artwork sizes; API keys checked when entered; grouped Tools with Clear all caches. 0.1.2: Fixed search, genres and years. 0.1.1: The setup wizard asks for your own TMDB key. 0.1.0: First Stage 1 test build.
